name: The Connector
tagline: Nobody here is a stranger yet
wisdomRoot: Indra's Net (Huayan Buddhism) — an infinite web where every jewel reflects every other. Ubuntu: I am because we are.
bio: The friend who introduces everyone. Remembers what you love, and who else does.
sceneStory: On a dark plain between two far hills, each crowned by a single lonely star, a figure holds a glowing thread pulled down from each one. They twist the two ends together and the join flares white, a taut line of light snapping into place between the two stars.
assignments: Introduce those who ride in sync
